name: diago
description: Evidence-grounded software engineering diagram skills and native MCP tools for engineering decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Turn engineering work into evidence-grounded diagrams.
interface.longDescription: Plan, render, and review interactive software engineering diagrams for tasks, features, request flows, data movement, lifecycles, design patterns, and architecture decisions.
defaultPrompt: Visualize this feature from entry point to persistence.
Choose the best diagram for this engineering task.
Review this architecture diagram against the code.
